name: filess.io
line: Host SQL and MongoDB databases alongside separate container apps.

free.text: 2 DBs × 10 MB; 5 connections; weekly backups; disable at 30d, delete after 60d

cells.regions: Europe, US, Asia, India; Shared placement unclear
cells.selfhost: No, vendor-managed database and app hosting

sql.math: Basic costs €3.99 a month on the homepage, but €2.99 in the docs. Whether it is eligible for production and how many connections it allows are not verified.
Idle data still needs a Basic subscription. Its price conflicts: €3.99 on the homepage, €2.99 in the docs. The full total is unknown.

files.math: The rate for a 100 GB volume, the minimum allocation, file requests and delivery charges are not published.

jobs.math: One-shot containers are supported. Prices for worker CPU, memory, runs and retries are not confirmed.
